description: Puerto Rico's kite, wing and windsurf spots as 787daily's wind hub lists them (/water/wind/): the sports, the wind directions a source says work, the water (flat, chop, waves), the level, the launch, hazards, local rules, the schools, the nearest measuring station and the NWS marine zone. Filter by sport, level, water, region and windFrom (a 16-point compass direction, e.g. 'ENE': spots a source names that wind for; spots with no direction named come back by name in windNotNamed). Also returns the rules that apply everywhere and whether any kite law exists. For the wind blowing now, use water_conditions_now. Cite the spot's url.

region.description: A region (san-juan, north, east, south, islands) or a town, e.g. 'Guánica'

name: find_wind_spots
title: Kite, wing and windsurf spots
